title: Terminal Operations Manual
summary: Use Terminal tabs, records, recipes, rewards, and linked pages as a compact operations layer.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: Terminal is the in-world operations console. It brings tabs and records together so players can make decisions without leaving the survival flow.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Open the terminal, check available tabs, and learn which systems publish records or recipes into it. Keep one terminal near your main staging area.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Open the relevant tab, review records or rewards, follow links into Wiki or Index, act on the plan, then return to update the terminal state.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Tabs, navigation pages, recipe views, reward tiers, mission pages, and linked records define the player-facing console surface.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: Wiki registers a Codex tab, Index can publish recipes, SignalOS can provide records, and TutorialCore can report terminal-opened progress.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If a tab is absent, confirm the owning addon is loaded and reopen the terminal after resources reload.
